title: Choosing Light: When an Earthquake Buried Me and My Family for 5 Days, I Learned to Fully Live
author: Katya Echazarreta-Saldaña
target_audience: Readers interested in true survival stories
People dealing with trauma, grief, or adversity
Fans of memoirs and personal journeys
core_themes: Resilience in the face of disaster
primary_purpose: To recount the harrowing experience of surviving five days trapped after an earthquake, and to share the lessons learned about hope, loss, and what it means to fully live each day after unimaginable hardship.

structure_format.organization: Chronological narration with chapters focused on the earthquake, rescue, and aftermath, interwoven with insights and reflections on survival and healing
features: Contextual background on the earthquake event

key_concepts_lessons: Moments of crisis reveal inner strength and priorities.
Hope and faith can sustain people during prolonged adversity.
Family bonds can provide comfort and motivation to survive.
Trauma fundamentally changes one’s perspective on life and death.
Healing requires facing pain, honoring memories, and making a conscious decision to embrace life again.
Small acts of courage, and the choice to keep going each day, are powerful.
notable_features: Firsthand account of surviving a natural disaster
Vivid descriptions of the earthquake, entrapment, and rescue
Examines the psychological complexities of trauma and grief
Offers practical hope and encouragement for readers overcoming hardship
cultural_historical_context: Centered on a major earthquake event (likely referencing the 2010 Haiti earthquake or another significant quake in recent history), the memoir situates individual experience within a broader context of natural disaster and its profound impact on families and communities.
reception_impact: Early praise for its deeply personal and inspirational narrative
Seen as a testament to resilience and the human spirit
Valued by readers seeking encouragement after loss or trauma
Resonates with those interested in survival stories and memoirs of overcoming adversity
